requirement.statement: The system SHALL define AI workflow app bundle resources using XNL-only authoring.

case.given: An AI workflow app bundle resource is authored
case.when: The resource is persisted in the bundle tree
case.then: The resource SHALL be represented as XNL

case.given: An AI workflow app bundle resource is authored as XML
case.when: The resource system validates the bundle
case.then: The system SHALL reject XML as a resource authoring format

requirement.statement: The system SHALL accept only logical, containment-safe resource references for AI workflow app bundle authoring.

case.given: A resource field contains a ref with an allowed scheme
case.then: The system SHALL accept the ref if it has no containment escape

case.given: A resource field contains a host absolute path or naked relative path
case.then: The system SHALL reject the ref
